title: Captain Hollanda Lima's encounter with a being in a space suit

tellings.quote: He himself actually saw an alien being that was in a space suit and and the the being sort of gave him a hug

plain: A Brazilian Air Force officer, Captain Uyrangê Hollanda Lima, himself saw an alien being in a space suit, and the being gave him a hug, Michels says. The captain is tied to Operation Prato, a Brazilian military operation in the Colares area of Pará state that began in 1977, and Michels cites its report. If true, it would be a first-hand close encounter reported by the officer in charge of an official investigation.
